facts.value: Graduate students have opportunities to learn from and engage collaboratively with renowned faculty across a wide range of fields.
An environment where research, creative work, and teaching are tested, refined, and reimagined.
A huge variety of special events that bring students and faculty into ongoing conversations.
Structured opportunities for professional development and mentoring.
ASU's Preparing Future Careers initiative helps students translate their graduate training into meaningful careers.
Departmental workshops, professionalization courses, and internship programs are widely lauded.
